public_by_category.map: function(doc) { if (doc.root_type === "survey" && doc.status === "published" && !doc.is_deleted) { if (doc.category && Array.isArray(doc.category)) { doc.category.forEach(function(cat) { emit(cat, null); }); } } }

profile_by_id.map: function(doc) { if (doc.root_type === "user" && !doc.is_deleted) { emit(doc._id, { first_name: doc.first_name, last_name: doc.last_name, email: doc.email, role: doc.role, profile_image: doc.profile_image, last_session: doc.last_session }); } }
